name: Isekai Revitalizer
storyline:
Gonzo Tanemaki lies in a hospital bed in a small island surrounded by his children who have come to say their last goodbyes. He has lived a long, fruitful life. His hard work and dedication to rebuilding the economy of his once-impoverished country led to the local people's respect. Some in the media had criticized his methods and lifestyle, but he wouldn’t have changed a thing. And so, at the ripe old age of 98, the curtain finally closes on his life... or so he thinks.

In the blink of an eye, Gonzo awakens to see a goddess who sends him off to a new world where exciting new adventures await! Who would've thought he'd end up in an elf village that would change his life forever...?!
summary: Explore the world of Miliene and watch as Gonzo’s saga unfolds in this story-driven visual novel! Meet the dynamic cast and experience a whole new world with Gonzo’s second chance at life. How will he take his 98 years of experience on earth and change this world? It’s up to you to find out!
